tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun blos mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur tshul bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ khyab bdag chen po ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed/ /gang gi zhabs pad rab dang gtsug rgyan gyis/ /lan brgyar mchod nas rwa chen gangs ri las/ /legs 'ongs rgyun phabs 'phags pa'i blo mtshor gnas/ /des gsung cho ga smin grol pad+ma'i tshal/ /rgyas shing gsal byed 'od stong bdag po gang / /rnam dpyod dbyings las brtse chen rta ljang gis/ /bskyod nas thub bstan shar ri'i rtse 'char gyis/ /don gnyer chu skyes ze'u 'bru bzhad par mdzod/ ༈ 'di la sta gon dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ /de yang thog mar sta gon bya ba'i sdom/ /bkod legs phun tshogs bshoms kyi bya ba dang / /sngon 'gro gtor mas mchod pa byin dbab cing / /zhu 'bul byas nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mthar/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus nas phyag gnyis nga rgyal gyis/ /mchod pa byin rlabs sa lha lha dang ni/ /bum pa slob ma'i sta gon rnam bzhi bya/ /de yang slob ma sta gon bya ba'i sdom/ /maṇ+ḍal phul nas sems bskyed nang dbang bskur/ /gsol btab spro ba bskyed de sdom pa byin/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs mchod pa lnga yis mchod/ /so shing khyor chu srung skud sku sha byin/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs mchod pa lnga yis mchod/ /chos bshad rmi lam rtags dang bcu bzhi'o/ /rjes la byin dbab mchod bstod dngos grub blangs/ /lhag chad bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ /dkyil 'khor stegs mchod bsrung smon shis pa brjod/ ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga bya ba'i sdom/ /bkod legs phun tshogs gshom gyi bya ba dang / /sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod pa byin dbab cing / /zhu 'bul byas nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mthar/ /dkyil 'khor 'dus nas phyag gnyis nga rgyal gyis/ /mngon par bshams pa'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/

/mdun gyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs bsgrubs/ /phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod cing bstod/ /phyi rol 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma bsngo/ /dbang gi don du bum pa bskyed nas ni/ /slob dpon bdag 'jug blangs te dbang bskur bya/ /dbang la phyi nang 'jug pa dbang bskur dngos/ /phyi 'jug khrus bya maṇ+ḍal gsol ba btab/ /gdong bcings me tog phreng ba gtad nas ni/ /bsang zhing dris lan sems bskyed gsang ba gdams/ /nang khrid phyag gsum byas nas sgo rnams dbye/ /phyag 'tshal bskor nas rgyun bshags sdom pa bzung / /phan yon nyes dmigs thun mong bka' nyan pa'i/ /sgo nas sngon 'gro'i dam bzhag rnam bzhi bya/ /dngos gzhi maṇ+ḍal gsol btab ye shes dbab/ /brtan par byas nas gsol gdab kha dog brtags/ /me tog dor zhing gdong g.yogs dkrol nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa nang du 'jug pa'i sdom/ /bcug nas dbang bskur dngos kyi sdom la ni/ /maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba lan gsum brtag /stegs 'khod dbang lha spyan drangs shis par brjod/ /chu dang cod paṇa rdo rje dril bu'i ming / /brtul zhugs dbang bskur rnams ni rim bzhin bya/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dbang gi sdom/ /sngon 'gro maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'dab/ /dngos gzhir rgyu lam 'bras gsum rdor 'dzin bskyed/ /thugs gsung sku yi dam tshig legs sbyin nas/ /dbang bskur rab gnas mchod de dag par brjod/ /mtha' rten sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang / /mchod pa brtul zhugs dam tshig mig sman dang / /chos 'chad las bzhi drag po dngos grub sbyin/ /dbang gi rtogs pa brjod dang bum dbang sdom/ /mchog dbang gsum la gsol btab dngos gzhi'i rjes/ /mtha' brten rnams ni kun la mtshungs pa sbyar/ /mjug tu khas blangs yon 'bul smon lam gdab/ /rjes la byin dbab mchod bstod dngos grub blangs/ /lhag chad bskang zhing bzod gsol brtan bzhugs bya/

/gnas gsum bsrung nas smon lam shis pa brjod/ /ces so/ /'di dag gi don nyams su blangs pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba gsum/ dang po ni/ bkod legs phun tshogs bshoms kyi zhes pa nas/ bum pa slob ma'i sta gon rnam bzhir bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi dkyil chog bzhin nyams su blangs/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod de/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la don thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i thugs bskyed byang chub kyi mchog tu bskyed la gsan par zhu/ de yang sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis/ rgyud rnam pa bzhi bka' stsal pas nang nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang gsum/ dang po la skyes bu 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor dang / gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ zhe sdang can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams so/ /phyi ma la gshin rje gshed dmar nag gnyis las/ nag po'i skor rtsa ba'i rgyud dgra nag le'u bco brgyad par/ bshad rgyud gdong drug dang / man ngag rgyud rtog bdun dang gnyis/ dang po la las thams cad grub pa'i 'khor lo'i rtog pa dang / rgyud rtog pa gsum pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /de rnams rtsa bshad yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgra nag dang por byung zhing bshad gzhir gyur pa yin la/ gzhan gnyis phyis 'byung zhing 'chad byed yin pas so/ /dang po sngon byung / ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/

srod la bar chad med pa'i lam gyis bdud btul/ tho rangs rnam grol lam gyis sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ srod la bdud thams cad kyis 'tshe ba rab tu mang po byung ba la thugs ka nas khro bo'i rgyal po dgra nag sprul te/ phyag na rdo rje la khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i gzugs su bsgyur te/ bdud dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang lha ma yin dang / lha rnams choms shig chings shig rtogs shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes dgra nag gi tshogs rab tu mang po sprul te bdud rnams btul lo/ /de'i tshe phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa 'dul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dgra nag gi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /dpal gdong drug gi rgyud 'di la tshigs bcad sum brgya sum cu gsum/ mngon par rtogs pa sum cu pa yin yang / brjod par bya ba'i gtso bo gang ston na/ bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i ting 'dzin ston/ de yang gang la dgongs nas ston ce na/ lha mo bai ta lis ma 'ongs pa'i dus na theg pa chen po dang sems can dag la 'tshe ba byung na/ ji ltar tshar bcad par bgyi zhes zhus pa dang / de'i don du bcom ldan 'das nyid gshin rje gshed zhal drug pa/ phyag drug zhabs drug shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i khro bo chen por gyur te rgyud 'di nyid gsungs so/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'di ni 'dul bya dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba la dgongs nas bshad/ de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ dbang phyug chen po dang u ma gnyis kyi bu gzhon nu gdong drug yin te de yang ji ltar yin zhe na/ sngon dbang phyug chen po dang u ma gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus su/ drang srong zhig yon slong du byung ba la u ma khros nas/ da lta'i dus su slong ba 'di 'brel pa ma yin zer nas rang gi chos 'byung gi nang na sa bon drod kyi bdag nyid me stag gi phung po ltar yod pa brus nas de'i khar blugs pas/

drang srong gi kha tshig te rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin te kha bkrus pa las/ sa bon me stag gi phung po yod pa la/ gzhon nu ma drug rgya mtshor khrus byas pas chags nas bsos pa las de la yid kyi bu gcig byung ste/ de la gcig na re nga'i bu yin zer/ yang gcig na re nga'i bu yin zer ba la/ drug ka dga' ba'i phyir gdong pa drug sprul pas de la gzhon nu gdong drug ces grags so/ /de dang lha ma yin gyi rgyal po ru tra gnyis 'dzam bu'i gling du 'thab pa las/ ru tra rgyal/ gzhon nu gdong drug pham pa la de'i dus na ri rab kyi khong seng lha min gyi gnas na dbang phyug chen po yod pa las/ 'dzam bu'i gling du bu pham par shes nas 'dod pa'i khams na dbang che shos dbang phyug chen po yin pas/ de'i sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i dmag tshogs dang sa 'og lha ma yin gyi rta pa'i tshogs dang / sa steng gi nad brgyad gdon brgyad kyi dmag nas lha ma yin gyi rgyal po ru tra pham par byas shing bu rgyal bar byas pa dang / de'i dus su ru tras 'phags pa 'jam dpal la skyabs su song bas/ 'jam dpal gyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnyen por phyag sum cu rtsa gnyis sprul/ sa 'og lha ma yin gyi rta pa'i gnyen por ma he'i gdong sprul/ sa steng gi nad brgyad gdon brgyad kyi gnyen por zhabs bcu drug sprul/ dbang phyug chen po nyid kyi gnyen por mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs par bstan nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum gsungs so/ /de rtsod pa'i dus kyi gang zag 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi ma go nas/ o rgyan gyi yul dharmā gha dz+nya chos kyi mdzod na mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyas btab nas longs spyod pa'o/ /des na gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor gyi rgyud bod du bsgyur ba la/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum po 'di nges so/ /'di la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang /

bod gangs can du ji lta dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni slob dpon la li ta badz+ra gyis o rgyan yul gyi dur khrod du bsgom byas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag nas rtog pa bdun pa 'di gang zag gi cha rkyen du bton pa'o/ /gnyis pa bod gangs can du ji ltar dar tshul la/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su ma byung zhing / phyi dar gyi dus su lcog gru shes rab bla ma zhes bya ba bod kyi rgyal po'i zhang rigs yin pas zhang zhes bya'o/ /des lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i stod la mnga' ris su byon te lo chen gyis grwa pa rdzu 'phrul che ru brtsegs pa gcig la gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / yo ga rnams bslab la/ lo chen la chos 'brel yud tsam byas/ de nas rgya gar du byon te grub chen a mo gha badz+ra chung ba la btugs nas dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka'/ dkyil chog gshin rje 'byung ba dang / dgra nag la sgrub thabs de nyid dang / gdong drug la slob dpon de wa a ka ra tsaṇ+ḍa'i sgrub thabs dang / 'jigs byed la la li ta badz+ra gyi sgrub thabs kyi steng nas gsan cing / rgyud gsum la 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i sngags kyi bshad pa legs po rnams gsan te bod du dar bar byas pa dang / yang bla ma snyos lo tsā ba rgya gar du byon te paṇ+ḍi ta bha ling+ta a tsar+ya la bdag na so rgas pas chos mang po mi lob cing / bod kha zan pas shin tu kha chod che ba/ mdo sngags thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pa/ gsang sngags yin pa gcig gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gnang / de nas bdag gi dgon pa de la rtsa gcig na yod pas de srung ba'i chos skyong zhig dgos zhus pas trag gshad gnang / bla mas chos skyong 'di 'tshub po zhig yong bar 'dra bas 'di gnon pa'i yi dam gyi khro bo zhig kyang gnang bar zhu zhus pas rdo rje 'jigs byed gnang ba sogs lugs srol mang du 'dug na yang 'di nyin rwa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin/

'dir 'chad par byed pa la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang bshad bya'i gdams pa dngos te gnyis/ dang po ni sangs rgyas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la/ des la li ta badz+ra la/ des a mo gha badz+ra la/ des ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa la/ des pad+ma badz+ra la/ des dī paṃ ka ra'am bal po thugs rje chen po la/ des rwa lo la'o/ /de yang rwa lo'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod na yul ni gnya' nam snang yul du/ rwa rdo rje grags pa zhes bya ba yin la/ dang po rwa lo la khyim mtshes kyi chags sdang chen por byung nas bal por byon te/ bla ma bha ro phyag rdum la gshin rje dgra gdong 'jigs gsum zhus te mkhas par bslab nas tshar bcad/ de'i tshe rong ban chen pos khong gi grags pa gsan nas rong du spyan drangs te rong yul dben dmar du bzhugs nas gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams dar bar mdzad/ des 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab par byung ngo / /des rwa chos rab la/ rwa ye shes seṅge/ rwa 'bum bzang / klog skya ngag dbang grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs nas rim par brgyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa de lta bu'i brgyud pa las byung ba'i dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor la yang rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba de nyid thob pa'i phan yon ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ des na gang zag dbang po rab/ /dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag dbang po yang rab rgyal chen in+t+ra bo dhi lta bu rnams dbang bskur rjes de ma thag grol bar bshad/ gsang ba'i mdzod las kyang / dbang bskur yang dag byin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur gsungs/ /de yis skye ba bdun nas ni/ /ma bsgom pa yang dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag mchog ma yin kyang dbang nyid la rtag tu goms par byas na skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs pa yin te/

slob dpon pad+mas dam tshig lnga pa las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag nas 'grub/ /ces dbang thob nas lam la 'bad par ma nus kyang / rtsa ba'i ltung bas ma gos na skye ba bcu drug nas mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub par gsungs/ de lta bu'i phan yon can gyi dbang de ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ dbang ma thob par bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don bsgom kyang dngos grub mi thob cing / gal te 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub phra mo tsam thob srid kyang phyi ma ngan song du 'gro ba gsungs pa yin te/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ de nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la yang dregs pa nges can dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga'am yang na bdun dag tu/ /nyi shu rtsa nas lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma bzung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa zhig dgos par gsungs/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i tshul la/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum las/ dang po sta gon la/ slob dpon la dgos pa'i las dang / slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa gnyis las/ slob dpon la dgos pa'i las la don tshan dgu yod pa legs par grub zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa la/ de yang slob ma sta gon du bya ba'i sdom/ zhes sogs la don tshan bcu bzhi yod pas/ khrus byas te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ chos bshad pa/ gsol ba btab pa/ byur gsal ba/ sdom pa sbyin pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ mchod pa bya ba/ so shing sbyin pa/ khyor chu blud pa/

srung bskud gdags pa/ ku sha sbyin pa/ spro ba bskyed pa/ gtor ma btang ba/ rmi lam bsgom pa'o/ /de lta bu'i don tshan bcu bzhi las/ khrus bya ba sogs sngon du song nas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs la maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gnyis pa chos bshad pa ni/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bshad la/ rjes su gnang ba'i gor bzhi po/ /rang gis blo dang shin tu ldan/ /theg pa chen po'i blo can la/ /bde gshegs yang dag cho ga gsungs/ /la la gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yin/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya'o/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di'i 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'byung / /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer gyis/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /de bas 'jig rten gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /khyod kyis bstan pa'i don gyis shig /de'i don ni/ tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa dang / longs spyod che ba la sogs pa yin la/ des mtshon 'jig rten pha rol tu lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa yin la/ de bas na khyed rnams kyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa don du gnyer ba sngags kyi dngos grub yin la/ de don du gnyer na tshe 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol gyi mngon mtho dang / nyan rang gi nges legs rnams kyang 'bad med du 'byung ste/ mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis kyang bstan pa 'di'i bdag po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i yid nges 'byung dang ldan par gyis shig

de yang rgyas par byed pa la chos bzhi dgos te/ gho tra ste bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ k+ṣe tra ste slob ma bzhi dang ldan pa/ bha ṭa ste dad pa dang ldan pa/ pra dz+nyā ste shes rab che ba zhig dgos/ gsum pa ni/ slob ma zhal nas bcug ste gsang gnas na gnas pa na/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te de nyid 'od du zhu nas gsang gnas su dbang bskur bas zhu ba'i thig le las gti mug gshin rje gshed du phyung ba mdun du gnas te gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod bdag dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid dam tshig rim pa dang / /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yis/ /khyod ni tshul can snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /dus gsum byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam pa med par brnyes/ /shākya seṅge sogs mchog gi /gsang sngags 'byor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gi stobs kyis bdud kyi sde/ /shin tu mi zad chen bcom nas/ gshin rje rjes 'jug bcad nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis slob dpon 'di gyis shig /ces pa'i don ni/ 'jig rten pa'i pha dang bu lta bu ma yin te/ chos las skyes pa'i bu yin/ khyed rnams theg pa chen po ste/ thabs rgya che ba gtso bor ston pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i snod yin cing / lam 'di yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam yin la/

'di la brten nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin cing / bstan pa 'di'i bdag po 'o skol gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa yang / nang don du gsang sngags kho na la bsten nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ zab mo rdo rje theg pa la brtson par gyis shig myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes brjod/ lnga pa ni/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyis byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas de'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces rgyun bshags byas la rig sngags spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa thams cad bzung du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs bcas kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sogs nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces rjes zlos lan gsum/ de'i don ni spyi'i dam tshig tshul khrims rnam gsum ma nyams par bsrung ba dang / so so'i dam tshig rnam snang gi dam tshig tu dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu dam tshig gsum gyi gnas lugs ston pa'i slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa/ rin 'byung gi dam tshig tu sbyin pa rnam bzhi dus drug tu gtong ba/ 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ don grub kyi yan lag tu sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang khyad par mchod pa'i las la brtson pa yin no/

/drug pa dung zhal nas dri chu blangs shing gnas gsum du dri yi thig le bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par byung ba'i mos par mdzod/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ mas yar btugs te hūm̐ sogs brjod pas/ snying khar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gsum byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pa la brten nas/ yas mar btugs te spyi bor sku rdo rje ma gsum sogs byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'bru gsum gong ltar lan gsum brjod/ bdun pa ni/ de ltar rdo rje gsum du gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas mchod lngas mchod pas mos par mdzod/ puṣ+pe nas nai wi te'i bar gyis mchod/ brgyad pa ni/ ba byung lngas maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa tshom bu lnga byas pa mdun ngos kyi sa gzhi la bkod la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ a shad u dum wa ra yi/ /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /ma yo ma gas srog chags med/ /rtse mor me tog brgyan pa byin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ so shing rnams/ ya man+ta kas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gis brgyan pa/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma 'byung ba'i nus ldan du gyur/ rtsa sngags kyis byin rlabs so shing rtse mor me tog gis brgyan pa/ khyod rang rnams kyi thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod la byin/ so shing 'dis so'i rtsa bar brud de maṇ+ḍal steng du dor bas sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin du tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam la/ rim bzhin langs te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha sa/ zhes brjod cing dor/ shar du rtse mo bstan na zhi ba/

lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ mtshams dngos grub phran tshegs re 'grub/ phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med do/ /so shing sbyin pa ni bum dbang gi snod rung du byas pa yin/ dgu pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ sngags kyis btab pa'i spos kyi chu khyor par blug ste lan gsum sbyin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ baṃ las skyes pa'i chu la baṃ lan bdun bzlas nas/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dharmā ni tsar+ya sarba saṃ shwa dha ya sarba bi ka pa la a pa na ye hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod la 'thung du gzhug des gsang dbang gi snod rung du byas pa yin no/ /bcu pa srung skud gdags pa ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ de nas mdud pa gsum byas pas/ /srung skud dpung pa g.yon du btags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ya man+ta kas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa gsum bsgril du byas pa la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha tshogs la phog de dag gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te dam tshig gi srad bu la gnyis su med par thim/ ya man+ta ka lan gsum bzlas pas byin rlabs/ de ltar srad bu 'di nyid skyes pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon la btags pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥṣ+ṭi bzlas zhing 'chings skor ba gnyis byas la mdud pa'i steng du nang mchod gtor/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba swāhā/ zhes brjod pa dang bcas rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la brtan par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas nas bdud la sogs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa yin/ des dbang phyi ma gnyis kyi snod rung du byas pa yin/ bcu gcig par/

spyi rgyud las/ ku sha myu gu rtse ma nyams/ /dhī las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pas rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal por byung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ hūm̐/ lan bdun brjod la byin brlabs/ dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che ba g.yas dang / hūm̐ las byung ba'i chung ba g.yon du byin la/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa dhīḥ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la che ba stan du dkyus dang chung ba 'phred du sngas su byin pas ku sha 'di dag byed kyi rdzas phun sum tshogs pa yin pa ltar rmi lam gyi ma dag pa bsal nas rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ku sha'i gdan la brten nas sangs rgyas pa ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyang 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe ku sha'i gdan rnams rtsol med du byung bas rten 'brel 'grig pa yin/ bcu bzhi pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med spyad pa nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad pa rgyu yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pas/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pas gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog de la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis spyod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/

/bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sangs nas rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po las byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na/ /rang byung bskal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gyur/ /de'i don ni u dum wa ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dkon/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dkon/ chos kyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsungs pa dkon te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ thugs rje chen po mar me mdzad nas 'od srung gi bar gyis kyang ma gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa na byams pa nas mos pa'i bar gyis kyang mi gsung / da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa kho nas smon lam gyi dbang gis gsungs pa yin pas shin tu dkon no/ /de la dkon pas ci ste/ nam mkha'i pad+mo dang / ri bong gi rwa yang dkon zhe na/ de dang ches mi mtshungs par dkon pa la ni phan yon chen po dang ldan te/ mar me chung ngu skyes ma thag tu bskal pa'i mun pa med par 'gro ba bzhin/ sang nub dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyis sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par 'gyur la/ dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyis phan yon de tsam yod na/ 'jug pa'i chos sngon du 'gro ba can gyis dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs la dbang bskur zab mo nos na/ sdig pa mang po 'dzad par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes sogs don bshad do/ /bcu gsum pa tshogs gtor ma byin rlabs la/ dkyil 'khor la bskal pa gcig drangs/ phud la gtor ma gcig byas/ tshogs la longs spyad/ de nas lhag ma 'dus la sngar ma bshams pa'i 'phrog ma chang zan gsum byin rlabs mtshungs/ oṃ hi ri ti si na ḍā kaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes brjod pas 'phrog ma la chang zan gsum gyi gtor ma byin/ oṃ hu ti ke a gha gra pa paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

zhes pas phud kyi gtor ma phul/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uṣ+ṇi ṣa bha ling+ta bak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la lhag ma'i gtor ma dbul lo/ /bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag par bya ba ni/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang par mgo bo dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas sngar byin pas ku sha che ba gdan dang chung bas sngas gyis la seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis rmi lam legs nyes kyi ltas sgug par gyis shig de ltar byas pas rmi lam bzang ba'i rtags ni nyi zla shar ba/ khrus byas pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ mtshon cha rnyed pa/ chur brgal ba la sogs pa rmis pa bzang la/ 'dam rdzab tu bying ba/ chu dong du lhung ba/ ri rtse nas lhung ba/ ljon shing chag pa/ khang thog rdib pa/ lha gas chag la sogs pa ni ngan pas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /bco lnga pa rjes la mchod bstod sogs nas/ dkyil 'khor stegs mchod bsrung smon shis pa brjod/ /ces pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga bya ba'i sdom/ bkod legs phun sum tshogs pa bsham gyi bya ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ slob dpon bdag 'jug blang te dbang bskur bya/ /zhes pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar byas la dbang bskur bya/ dbang la phyi nang 'jug pa dbang bskur dngos/ /zhes sogs kyi don ni/ slob ma rnams bos la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pas thugs bskyed byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas gsan 'tshal/ spro na gsang sngags spyi'i che ba dang sgos kyi che ba cung zad brjod/ ces pas/ de la sta gon dngos gzhi gnyis las sta gon gyi bya ba kha sang phul ba de yin/ dngos gzhi la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod la/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dga' ba chen po'i bde ba chen po'i ngo bo slob dpon khyod ni bdag gi ston pa yin gyis/ khyod kyis bdag la thar pa chen po'i grong mchog dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas phyag me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ ro langs ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de nas gdong bcing ste me tog gi phreng ba gtad pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis sngon chad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang slar 'jug pa mtshon byed kyi brdar gdong ras yug dmar po res bcing ba'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥkhaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcing rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog blangs/ u dum wa ra man+da ra/ /yongs 'dus dang ni ma li ka /karni ka yi phreng ba 'di/ /legs par nod de bus zungs shig /dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe lag stong par mjal du mi rung bas/ phyag rten du u dum wa ra 'di phul mdzod/ ā khaṃ sogs brjod/ gsang zhing dris lan sems bskyed gsang ba gdams pa ni las bum gyi chu gtor zhing / oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba zab mo bsgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu blangs shing / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dris lan ni/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris lan gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan btab nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do/

/de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /sems bskyed ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ bden gnyis dbyer med kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta uta pa dā ya mi/ sems bskyed brtan par bya ba'i phyir khyed rang gi snying khar rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ gsang ba gdams pa ni rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ dus 'di nas ni khyod nyid kyi/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin/ /de yis sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig de nyid ma mthong bas/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan gnas par gyis/ /nang du 'khrid pa ni shar sgo nas 'khrid par bsam la/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa zhig byung ste/ des khyed rang gi lag g.yas nas 'khrid nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ da dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag 'tshal ba ni thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ na mā te hūm̐/ mgrin par sbyar la na ma mi hūm̐/ snying khar sbyar la na mo na ma hūm̐/ sgo dbye ba ni gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sgo ba rnams kyis sgo dbye bar bsam la spyi bor sbyar te/ oṃ badz+ra ur+gha ṭa sa ma ya pra pe sha ya hūm̐/ phyag 'tshal bskor nas zhes pa'i don ni/ shar nas gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol ba'i yid kyis spyi bor sbyar ste/

oṃ sarba tā thā ga tā pu dza u pa tha na ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta at+ma mo han ta kṛta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ lho sgo nas ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis dbang bskur ba gsol ba btab pas yid kyis dpral bar sbyar ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza a bhi ṣe ka ta at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga tā at+ma bi shu nan+ta kṛta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ nub sgo nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis chos ston par gsol ba btab pa'i yid kyis mgrin par sbyar ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pu dza pra warta nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta at+ma ra gan ta kṛta dharmā tsakra pra warta na ya maṃ/ byang sgo nas phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis 'phrin las bzhi sgrub par gsol ba btab pa'i yid kyis yang spyi bor sbyar ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pu dza karma ṇi at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga tā at+ma ir+ṣan ta kṛ ta karma ku ru maṃ/ yang shar sgo nas 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal gyis dngos grub thams cad stsol bar gsol ba btab pas yid kyis/ snying khar sbyar ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya waka tsit+ta swa bha wa badz+ra a tsar+ya pā da ni ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu maṃ/ rgyun bshags ni dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyis byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces rgyun bshags byas la rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa thams cad bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs lan gsum/

phan yon nyes dmigs thun mong bka' nyan cing / sgo nas sngon 'gro dam bzhag rnam bzhi bya/ zhes pa'i don ni 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa thams cad skal ba dang mi ldan pa gzhan la ma smra zhig ces pa'i don du phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yis khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de ltar phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la ma nyan par gsang ba'i don gzhan la smras na nyes pa chen po 'di lta bu 'byung ste/ ye shes phab pa'i dus su rdo rje sems dpa' thang cig snying la bzhugs kyang slar bya tshang nas bton pa bzhin ye shes pa rnams gshegs pas zhes pa'i don du nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying khar bzung la/ gshin rje gshed dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /de yis bstan pa'i gsang ba 'di/ /dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams dang / /gang yang gzhan la smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu sbyin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig bzlas na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob/ /'thungs shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ khyad par du dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la rag las pas/ slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/

/gshin rje gshed po nga yin gyi/ /nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis/ /gang yang nga la brnyas pa min/ /de bzhin mos par ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis/ /de ltar dam la bzhag nas dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal gshin rje gshed bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ da khyed rang rnams ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa langs nas rkang pa bsgrad de bar snang la yod pa rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdungs pa lta bu 'chang zung dang mchog ma la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin can re re/ snying khar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snying kha'i nang du 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ mgrin par chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po has mtshan pa/ de nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la dad gus dung dung byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rkang 'og gi rlung gi ba dan la phob pas rlung g.yos rkang mthil gnyis kyi dzhaiṃ las me 'bar te lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ snying kha'i sa dmar po tshig mgrin pas chu 'khol bas lus la bde drod kyi nyams dpag tu med pa skyes/ de'i tshe spyi bo'i rlung kha thur du mnan/ rkang 'og gi rlung gyen la btegs/ me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros shing bya sgro rlung gis bskyod pa ltar bar snang la yed yed yod pa la/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥsogs dang / oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a we sha ya hūm̐/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ āḥhāṃ/ dzhaiṃ/ de ltar ye shes pa phab pas/ sku babs na 'phar ba dang g.yo ba/ gsung babs na smra ba la sogs pa/ thugs babs na mi rtog pa skye ba yin/ de ltar babs pa'i ye shes pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ nang du 'jug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /gshin rje gshed dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /lan gsum/ kha dog btags pa yid kyis bya/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtags pa ni/ bar snang gi kha dog 'dra ba la khyed rang rnams gdong g.yogs dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor steng gi khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' stong pa la cer gyis gzigs pas kha dog dkar dmar sogs gang dang gang mthong ba de nyid slob dpon gyis dris pas tshe 'di dang 'di lta bur mthong zhes lan btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ kyai khyod kyi mig lam na 'od kyi snang ba ji lta bur mthong / zhes bris la dkar po mthong na zhi ba'i las 'grub/ zhes sogs dang dkyil 'khor la me tog dor cing / de nas ye shes phab pa dang mthun par rigs kyi lha ngos 'dzin pa la me tog dor bar byed pa yin te/ gang la dor bar byed pa'i yul ni dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ gdul bya'i blor snang la che chung dang bzang ngan gtso 'khor gyi rnam par snang ba yin gyis rang gi ngo bo la bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes gcig nyid las grub pa yin pas che chung gtso 'khor sogs kyi khyad par cung zad kyang med la/

rang gi sngon las kyis bsags pa'i lha zhig la phog par shog snyam pa'i bsam pas/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu yi gtsug tor du phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar me tog phog pa ni rigs kyi lha yin/ de ngos 'dzin par byed la mig gis blta dgos shing / de la gdong g.yogs phye dgos pas/ khyod rang rnams kyis oṃ yig 'bar ba re re las 'od zer 'phros pas ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs thams cad dang bral ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma hā pū dza pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ me tog rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing / pra ti gṛh+na satwaṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la oṃ/ gdong g.yogs phye ba'i tshul dang / gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /heḥbadz+ra pa sh+ya/ oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ma hā maṇ+ḍal la pra we sha ya phaṭa/ de ltar gdong phye bas slob ma la dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ba yin pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la gzigs par zhu/ de la slob dpon gyis lha ngo bstan par byed pa yin te/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba 'bar bas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i sa gzhir rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dang steng du langs pa'i pu shus brgyan pa/

rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang sprin dang me dang chu dang / mchod rten dang / klu dang bcas shing grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang srin po dang / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang / 'byung po'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang bas bskor ba'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba sgo tshad gcig dang ldan pa dbus sngo ba'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng bas zlum por bskor ba'i nang re'u mig dgu dang ldan pa'i dbus su ro mgo med lag med dang / phyogs mtshams kyi re'u mig rnams dang lha snam gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad phyag mtshan rnams dang bcas pa'i gnas su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can/ de las tshad med pa'i 'od zer 'phros gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing /

g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pa'i phyag gis ut+pa lar gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas bklubs shing / 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phro ba/ zhi ba/ 'dzum pa dang / sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥyig ring cha tshag drag dang bcas pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro tshogs dpag tu med par spyan drangs/ 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi phung por gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ a ā/ i ī/ sogs nas/ aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga nas/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣi ya/ ya k+ṣi ya ts+tsha ni rā ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ sogs/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang rang gi sgra 'brug gi dbyangs bzhin sgrog bzhin pa dpag tu med par bkug la thim pas hūm̐ gi yi ge mthing nag chen po zhig tu gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje dang / gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa shin tu gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ hūm̐ de las yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa'i snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs su byas nas slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu 'dus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/

/thugs rje'i gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed/ /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyangs rnam par 'gyings nas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong / /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog /steng zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can cung zad khro/ /g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril shing / /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ /g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing dang / /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig par/ /dgra satwa mdung mda' lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang / /ral gri rnge'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang / /ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang / /'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyi rim bzhin du/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mong khyi lug ce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang / /'ug pa khra dang bya rog dang / /ne tso khyung chen ri skegs bzhed/ /mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang / /drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams/ /'gyel nas kha sbub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis/ /khro zhal rnams kyis dbu la brgyan/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang / /sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas/

/dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang / /khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang / /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan/ /liṅga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /de'i shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa/ lha snam la shar sgo'i g.yas nas gri gug 'phang mdung / gtun shing / g.yon nas chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ lcags kyu/ lho sgo'i g.yas nas dgra satwa/ mda'/ dbyig pa/ g.yon nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ nub sgo'i g.yas nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rnge'u chung / phub/ g.yon nas gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang sgo'i g.yas nas sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang po che'i pags pa/ g.yon nas tho ba/ mdung / me thabs rnams dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad du bhaiṃ gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i ro langs chen po brgyad mdog nag po lce brkyangs nas ha ha zhes drag tu rgod pa la gdengs shing / dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal shing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /gang mthong zhing khams rnam dag mchog /bla na med pa'i gnas mchog yin/ /rdo rje thugs ka'i rgyun gnas pas/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun mi chad/ /bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis mthong / /phun sum tshogs kun 'dis 'grub 'gyur/ /dngos grub 'grub phyir dam tshig skyongs/

/gsang sngags don la brtson par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad dngos su mthong ba yin snyam du mos/ des phyi nang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams song nas/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ ji ltar rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpar dbang bskur ltar/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /bdag la don mchog stsal tu gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas dbang stegs su 'khod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i spyi bor gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ phyogs thams cad mchod pa'i sprin bkram pas bskor bar gyur/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ slob dpon gyi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ las kyi rdo rjes bum pa gnyis bteg gzhan rnams kyis rol mo dang me tog gi char dbab cing / bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /ma lus rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po dam pa rje/ /gsang ba'i snying po sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig mchog /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur shog /phun sum tshogs pa sogs gsum dang / nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod/ de nas chu dbang ni/ ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gsum ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa re re/

de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gsum ka rgyu'i 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying bag dang bcas pas rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yā las rdo rje yās mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gsum ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang rdzas la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha de las de 'dra ba gcig mched/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ de bzhin 'di la dbang bskur gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ud+dha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od sngon po byung / rang rang gi lus yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal ma he'i gdong pa can phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing / rang 'od kyi shes rab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ bdag gi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dren pa dus mnyam du byas/ hūm̐ yum gyi bha ga nas spros/ khyed rang gi gnas rnams su 'khod par gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa bzang ba yin pas/ mchod pa lngas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/

zhe sdang dag gshin rje gshed kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// ༈ /cod paṇa gyi dbang ni ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gsum ka rgyu'i 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mā las rin po che māḥs mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gsum ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha de las de 'dra ba gcig mched/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu brgyan du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod la/

'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi cod paṇa dbang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir/ /cod paṇa mchog gis dbang bskur bas/ /'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal mchog dbang bskur/ /oṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ hūm̐ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chus lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /yon tan rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od zer ser po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi lus yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ ser sna gshin rje gshed sku mdog ser po ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas kyis gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing / rang 'od kyi shes rab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa dus mnyam du byas/ hūm̐ yum gyi bha ga nas spros rang gi gnas rnams su 'khod par gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas mchod pa lngas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin la/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas rdo rje gsum ka rgyu'i 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pa'i ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas rdo rje gsum ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sogs/

'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha de las de 'dra ba gcig mched/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la sogs/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje mchog gi dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa ya mi/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /gsung gi rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od zer dmar po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi lus yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po zhal ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing / rang 'od kyi shes rab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas zhugs/

thugs kar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa dus snyam du byas/ hūm̐ yum gyi bha ga nas spros/ rang rang gi gnas rnams su 'khod par gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas mchod pa lngas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// ༈ dril bu'i dbang ni/ ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas dril bu gsum ka mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas dril bu gsum ka rgyu'i 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du da las ral gri das mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas dril bu gsum ka'ang don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sogs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha de las de 'dra ba gcig chad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ chos kyi dril bu bla med don/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrogs pa/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pa ta le dharmā dhastu a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sogs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dpal ldan 'phrin las rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin byis brlabs nas su/ /'phrin las rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od ljang khu byung / khyed rang rnams kyi lus yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu zhal ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/

dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing / rang 'od kyi shes rab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu sku'i dbyibs brgyud khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa dus mnyam du byas/ hūm̐ yum gyi bha ga nas spros rang rang gi gnas rnams su 'khod par gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ mchod pa lngas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// ༈ ming gi dbang ni ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag nyid dang slob ma rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag dang slob ma gnyis ka'ang rgyu'i 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan cing / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa re re/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/

bdag nyid dang slob ma rnams rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sogs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ da de ltar gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /ming gi dbang ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ya hūm̐/ kyai dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la'o/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing sogs nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /sku yi rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od zer dkar po byung khyed rang rnams kyi lus yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po/ zhal ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing /

rang 'od kyi shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud khyed rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur ba dang / ye shes pa 'dres pa dus mnyam du byas/ hūm̐ yum gyi bha ga nas spros rang rang gi gnas rnams su 'khod par gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas na/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa lngas kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi bag chags dang sogs// ༈ brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ ya man+ta kas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las khyed rang rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sogs/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa' yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la slob dpon gyis hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa re re khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dhā ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hī/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de'i don ni/ khyed rang rnams de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin snyam par mos la/ deng phyin chad tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog sdug bsngal dang bcas pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gnas par gyis shig des brtul zhugs kyi dbang thob/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kye ho khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyis stsal tu gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dngos gzhi rgyu lam 'bras gsum rdor 'dzin bskyed pa ni/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rin po che'i khri chen po pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gi rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon par ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsum du bdag sgrubs shig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od zer sngon po byung / rang rang gi lus thams cad yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ mig byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur ba dang / ye shes pa 'dres pa dus mnyam du byas par mos/ hūm̐ yum gyi bha ga nas spros/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas rnams su 'khod par gyur pa de nyid la/ thugs gsung sku'i dam tshig gsum rim pa bzhin sbyin pa ni khyed rang rnams rdo rje gsor bzhin pas/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa re khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nas/ hi hi hūm̐ bar/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid ni 'di yin te/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje thugs kar bstod la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ de'i don ni rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo yin no/ /dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa re khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yon par sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dril bu dkrol te/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyings kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /de'i de kho na nyid ni 'di yin te/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje thugs kar bstod cing dril bu dkur brten la/ āḥ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/

/srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ de'i don ni dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i sgra yin no/ /sku'i dam tshig sbyin pa ni phyag rgya'i rdor dril bsnol te/ da nas phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor bas/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams 'du bar bgyi/ /de'i de kho na nyid ni 'di yin te/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis zungs/ /'dod pa'i log spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /de'i don ni/ tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa yin la/ de bas na srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor gyis 'dod pas longs spyod pa thams cad la longs spyod cig ces pa'i don no/ /de ltar khyed rang rnams la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa de nyid brten pa'i yan lag tu/ slob dpon gyis bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur dgos pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha slob dpon dang bcas pas bum pa lag tu thogs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/

/oṃ badz+ra ud+dha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de ltar khyed rang rnams khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyis rab tu gnas par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ lan gsum la sogs pa brjod la me tog gtor/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams gshin rje gshed kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa la slob dpon gyis mchod pa lngas mchod pas mos par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ bar gyis mchod/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob nas/ de kho na nyid bstod pa yin pas/ dag pa brjod pa ni/ de yang gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin la/ dur khrod kyi lus dang 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams/ rnam par dag pa yin cing / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / lha rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / yon tan dang 'phrin las rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang / de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la tshang ngo / /de ltar na de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag des gzhan don byed pa la rjes gnang thob dgos pas/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni/ 'di ru 'jam dpal gyi bskyed chog sogs gong sgrub thabs ltar dgos pa min nam snyam/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa shin tu gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang /

bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs su byas/ slar 'dus shing thim pa yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu 'dus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed/ /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyangs rnam par 'gyings pas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong / /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog /steng zhal dmar po rgya chen bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can cung zad khro/ /g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing / /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ /g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing 'dzin/ /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /dgra satwa mdung mda' lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang / /ral gri rnge'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang / /ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug /me thabs thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang / /'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyi rim bzhin du/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mo khyi lug ce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang / /'ug pa khra dang bya rog dang / /ne tso khyung chen ri skegs bzhed/

/mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang / /drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams/ /bsgyel nas kha phub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yi/ /khro zhal rnams kyis dbu la brgyan/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang / /sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang / /khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang / /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan/ /liṅga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /kha sbyor bde ba chen po'i tshul/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /de ltar gsal bar dmigs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ mig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra l+yā se hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ma le traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghirti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nīrti āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo kā+e hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ zhes sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/
