/rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra u bhi ṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsungs shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ thams cad kyis khro bo'i phyag mtshan dang chas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang / dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ khyad par du khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan/ de la slob dpon gyi snying kha nas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu rnams spros te dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas par bsam zhing / phyag rgya rnams kyai rdor bzhin mdzad la/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+ḍe hoḥ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bas/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du mched do/ /slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ste ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du sngags phreng rnams 'khod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/

oṃ ya ma ra dza sa do me ya/ ya ma du ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags dang / oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wiṣ+ṭi ta na na hūm̐ phaṭa snying po dang / oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa nye snying rnams lan gsum re'i rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs lan gsum/ slar yang slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba me tog tu byin gyis brlabs pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gsung gi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gri gug che/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi gri gug dam pa 'di/ /rmongs pa'i mgo bo gcod phyir khyer/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam dag gi /mgo bo pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar gyis/ /mchod pa ni/ gdugs kyi gdong la bltas nas ni/ /bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can gyur/ /bud med rnams kyis yongs bskor la/ /kun nas brtse ba'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams byas pa gang yin pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs ni/ mchog gi dngos grub thams cad ni/ /brtul zhugs mchog gis bsgrub par bya/ /de phyir gshin rje 'joms pa yi/ /brtul zhugs rnam pa kun tu spyod/ /phal cher dngos grub mchog rnams ni/ /brtul zhugs med par mi 'grub pas/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs 'di/ /legs mchod mchog gi dngos grub 'grub/ /dam tshig ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur la sogs pas/ /sangs rgyas la sogs thob pa bzhin/

/byang chub spyod tshogs gzhan dag dang / /'dul sogs dge bas de lta min/ /de bas dam tshig bus srungs shig /rtag tu sdom pa yang bzung ngo / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ste/ /de las gzhan pa'i dam tshig bsrungs/ /dkon mchog gnod pa bsad bya zhing / /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /pha rol nor ni blang bya zhing / /rtag tu rdzun gyi tshig kyang smros/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang gsungs pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrungs/ /da khyed rang rnams kyi mig tu sgrib byed pa khams kyi rang bzhin yi ge ṭaṃ re rer bsam la/ slob dpon gyis gser gyi thur ma sor drug pa zhig gis bsal te ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs thams cad dang bral nas rig pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mig sman ni/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal bar ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa hā ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥtrāṃ/ chos 'chad pa ni/ rkang mthil du 'khor lo/ lag g.yas dung / g.yon du dril bu/ bar du po ti byin la/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med par/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /las bzhi ni/ zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyi rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen char sprin rab skor bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dbang gi las ni yang dag bsgrub/ /bsad pa'i sems kyi drag po ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /drag po ni/

sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri gcig pu mchog /bdud las rgyal ba bya phyir bzung / /oṃ khaṅga hūm̐/ dngos grub ni/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil l+h+wam de bzhin dril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ de ltar na khyod kyi phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du byas pa yin no/ /de nas gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyobs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /gdong g.yogs 'ching ba'i tshul dang / khyed rang rnams sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs par mtshon pa'i brdar gdong g.yogs rnams 'ching bar zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid phyungs nas bdag gi lce thog tu blangs/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang 'di la rje btsun yab las thob pa dang / yum las thob pa dang / grol ba'i stobs kyis thob pa dang gsum las/ 'di grol ba'i stobs kyis thob pa yin la/ de la khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje 'jigs byed du mos shing / rig ma ro langs mar gsal ba de nyid snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa de nyid phyungs nas khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/

btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /bu khyod de ltar shes gyis la/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de ltar khyed rang rnams sngar gyi bdud rtsi byin pa myang zhing / 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu/ a ho ma hā su kha/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ de thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas/ de thams cad la mi rtog pas khyab pa'i ngang la ma yengs pa tsam du mnyam par bzhag dbang de thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' brten du lung bstan pa ni/ sprul sku'i lung ston pa yin pas/ slob dpon shākya thub pa'i cha lugs su lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar 'chang la/ ma 'ongs pa na gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par lung ston pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /gshin rje gshed dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las ston/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum du sarba bhur bhu wa swāhā/ gang yang ngas lung bstan pa 'di la dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /'on kyang gsang ming yid la bsam dgos kyi ngag tu mi 'don/ de ltar na nang bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam rang byin brlab bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /slar yang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs kyis gsol ba btab/

gdong g.yogs 'ching ba'i tshul bya zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dang po phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang gi don du khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ro langs ma de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das kyi yum de las de 'dra ba gcig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung nas khyed rang rnams la byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /gzung ma 'di ni yid 'ong ma/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs/ /'khor lo'i rim pas spyod pa yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rig ma des dga' bzhi'i ye shes la rtogs med du spyod nus sam zhes dris par bsam la/ bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang / /khrag dang de bzhin khu ba ste/ /sha chen brten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mo 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /rang nyid kyis lan btab par bsam la/ de khyed rang rnams kyis bsrung nus zhes lan btab par mos la 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ ci gsung dam tshig bstan pa ni/ /lha mo bdag ni spro gyur to/ /zhes pa'i lan btab pas phyag rgya ma de dgyes nas lus gcer bur phyung / chu skyes gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas/ rtsa mchog tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma ston bzhin du/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin brten na/ /de'i mdun na bdag 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /satwaṃ pad+ma bhañtsa mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs shing khyed rang rnams kyi pang du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/

hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swa ser po/ brla gnyis la aṃ ljang khu re re/ khyed rang rnams dang phyag rgya ma lhar gsal ba lus lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa ngag sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa yid chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ khams dwangs ma spyi bo nas mgrin par babs pas dga' ba/ snying khar babs pas mchog dga'/ lte bar babs pas dga' bral/ rdo rje'i rtser bab pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i tshe byang sems dkar dmar zhal mjal zhing bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la yun ring du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod de rlung yar thim pas khams dkar dmar 'dres par gsang gnas nas lte bar drangs pas dga' ba/ snying khar drangs pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par drangs pas dga' bral/ spyi bor drangs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de'i tshe dga' bral gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis bkram pas lus sems bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la yun ring du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams la dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas gdong g.yogs phye bar mos la/ de'i mtha' brten du lam gyi dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/

/sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga ni/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thog drin du gzo bzhin du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /de yang 'dod cing chags pa'i yul ni bzhi ste/ dad pa can lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ shes rab can chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa/ snying rje can sems can gyi don la chags pa/ bde ba can byang chub kyi sems la chags pa dang bral ba las sdig pa che ba khams gsum na med pas/ khyod kyis de dag ma bral bar bslab par bya'o/ /de ltar gsang ba kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /des gsang dbang thob nas/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na/ /blos ni yongs su mi bsgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid mi shes na/ /de kho na nyid bsgom min te/ /dngos po thams cad yongs shes na/ /de ni bsgom par rab tu grags/ /khyed rang rnams kyi lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems dug gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'phrul gzhan thams cad la brtan g.yo'i snod bcud thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems su nges pa'i shes pa bskyed de/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku bzhi rang chas su gnas pa de nyid 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi dang ngo bo dbyer med du nges shes bskyed de/

'dir sngar bshad pa'i nyams len thams cad spros bral du ngo sprod pa yin pas/ yul ci yang ma grub la/ blos cir yang 'dzin mi shes par snang / gsal stong bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang la yun ring du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs rnams phye ba'i mos pa mdzod la/ gzengs bstod pa ni/ de ring khyod bdag legs par rnyed/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/ /sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter/ /phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas/ /gsang sngags mnyam pa med las grub/ /zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /mthong ba'am yang ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /byang chub sems mchog rmad byung rnyed/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyi/ /skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pas/ /phyag na rdo rje da gyur to/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yi/ de ring khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa bag chags dang bcas pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam shin tu spros med bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /des dbang gi dngos gzhi song nas/ gnas skabs de dag tu khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la bsrung sdoms tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ des rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod dang bcas pa bla ma la yon du 'bul/

cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ 'o des bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang / rjes kyi bya ba rnams dkyil chog bzhin bya'o/ /smras pa/ dhīḥyig yongs gyur rgyal sras po ral 'chang / /lnga bdo'i 'gro la brtse ba'i spyan yangs kyis/ /gzigs te ring min yid can ma ma rnams/ /theg chen lam gyi grong khyer chen po ru/ /'khrid byed hūm̐ yig spros pa'i zlos gar las/ /rab brjid khro chen gshin rje gshed po yi/ /dbang gi mtshams sbyor kun blo'i 'chad ltar la/ /blo gros tsak+ṣu sgrib pa'i 'gro ba yis/ /brjod bder bklag phyir kho bo sa skya pa/ /gsang bdag dpal chen 'od por 'bod pas bris/ /dge bas 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// //maṅga laṃ/ /bha wan+tu// // 'di la sbyar byang mi snang ba kun blos mdzad pa'i ma dpe khungs dag gcig la zhu dag bya dgos yod// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 42 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 41
